name: bgGLUE
description: We present bgGLUE(Bulgarian General Language Understanding Evaluation), a benchmark for evaluating language models on Natural Language Understanding (NLU) tasks in Bulgarian. Our benchmark includes NLU tasks targeting a variety of NLP problems (e.g., natural language inference, fact-checking, named entity recognition, sentiment analysis, question answering, etc.) and machine learning tasks (sequence labeling, document-level classification, and regression). We run the first systematic evaluation of pre-trained language models for Bulgarian, comparing and contrasting results across the nine tasks in the benchmark. The evaluation results show strong performance on sequence labeling tasks, but there is a lot of room for improvement for tasks that require more complex reasoning. We make bgGLUE publicly available together with the fine-tuning and the evaluation code, as well as a public leaderboard at https://bgglue.github.io/, and we hope that it will enable further advancements in developing NLU models for Bulgarian.
evaluation_method: task-specific (accuracy for classification, F1 for NER/sequence-labeling, exact_match / F1 for QA, etc.)
general_score_metric: task-specific (accuracy / F1 / exact_match depending on task)
reputation: Established national benchmark for Bulgarian NLU with a public leaderboard; used as the standard evaluation suite for Bulgarian language models.
notes: Text-only (non-LLM-specific) multilingual/national benchmark; per-task dataset sizes vary and some tasks remain challenging (reasoning-heavy tasks show room for improvement).
